name: Sevrin Inkseal

anatomy.description: athletic adult-proportioned humanoid biped with complete bare hands and feet

design: exhausted court magistrate in layered burgundy robes and a huge tablet pauldron, carrying a multi-headed law stamp; no Death Prophet or Silencer-style global silence
prompt: Clean base reference for Sevrin Inkseal. Attached drawing is identity and proportions reference only. Older adult human male magistrate, lean build. Fully covered plain seamless matte gray close-fitting unitard from neck to wrists and ankles, no loose cloth. Bald, no beard. Bare hands and feet. No costume, hair, jewelry, tools, vehicles, weapons, accessories. Front orthographic full body neutral wide symmetrical A-pose, straight arms angled 45 degrees down/out, separated fingers, clear armpit gaps, straight legs slightly apart. Entire head hands feet visible with 12% transparent margin. Neutral gray sculpt, readable joints, no floor, shadow, text or halo. One adult base only.
